name: Hallrin IV
description: Hallrin IV was an Expansion Region world in the Hallrin system. The Stratis Games, including the Multi-Sentient Unarmed Combat Rounds, were held on Hallrin IV. Clyngunn represented the ZeHethbra in these Rounds.
